scope: Separate artist experiment; these metrics do not evaluate Waveform track playlists
protocol: One SHA-256-selected artist held out for every user with >=5 positives; fixed SHA-256 cohort of 100 users; train-only features/popularity; query user excluded from neighbors
limitations: Small fixed cohort, one positive per user, no negatives or temporal split; unobserved does not mean disliked.
Historical artist benchmark, no verified track mapping, no tuning/test separation study or track-quality claim.
